name: Remote Video Appearance Expansion for Regional Registries
description: Deploy dedicated high-definition video appearance suites and network bandwidth upgrades across 14 rural and regional court registries to expand access to justice and reduce sheriff escort travel.
recommendation: Fund and deploy across Phase 1 priority regional registries

name: Automated Multi-Jurisdiction Court Scheduling & Judicial Rota Engine
description: Cross-jurisdictional automated scheduling engine coordinating judicial sitting rotas, courtrooms, court clerks, and sheriff escorts across Provincial and Supreme Courts.
sponsor: Assistant Deputy Minister, Court Services Branch
recommendation: Fund 6-month discovery spike and judicial governance consultation before capital allocation

name: Digital Exhibit & Evidence Intake Vault
description: Secure, tamper-evident digital evidence repository with cryptographic chain-of-custody verification for multimedia evidence submitted by police, Crown, and defence.
recommendation: Proceed with procurement of certified digital evidence SaaS platform and pilot

name: Custom Microfilm Archival Re-scanning Hardware Project
description: Procurement of specialized optical robotic scanners to digitize historical 1960-1980 microfilms stored in basement archive vaults.
recommendation: Decline bespoke hardware purchase; utilize standard provincial archival scanning service on demand

name: Online Self-Service Violation & Fine Dispute Resolution Portal
description: Public-facing self-service web portal for reviewing traffic and provincial statute violations, requesting extensions, and submitting written dispute statements.
recommendation: Deliver opportunistically using existing B.C. Gov digital forms platform
